ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, which species is a producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a marine food web, with “plankton 1.7 ppb” labeled at the lower right, and “seawater 0.0001 ppb” labeled at the bottom. An arrow points from seawater to the enlarged area of plankton, and other arrows point from plankton to consumers such as fish and squid. The picture also shows higher-level organisms such as fish, squid, seabirds, and dolphins. Reasoning: The question asks to find the producer in the food web. Producers are usually located at the basic level of the food web, can make food, and are eaten by consumers. In the picture, plankton is located at the basic position and provides energy to consumers such as fish and squid, so the producer is plankton.
